sources.snippet: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit for deploying high-performance AI solutions across cloud, AI PCs, edge devices, and Physical AI alike. Develop your applications with both generative and conventional AI models, coming from the most popular model frameworks. Convert, optimize, and run inference utilizing the full potential of Intel® hardware.
